fullPassage: When self-experimentation and conventional experiments are both possible, the difference between them often resembles the difference between learning and showing: Self-experiments are better for discovery but worse for convincing others that the solution is helpful or the answer is correct. Of course, most scientists want to do both—discover something and convince others of their discovery. Thus, psychologists should consider doing both self-experiments and conventional ones. The best use of resources may often be self-experiments followed by conventional ones. The researcher begins with self-experiments that, if all goes well, find large effects and/or generate and eliminate many hypotheses. This exploratory and theory-building phase lasts until a convenient solution or large effect is found. Then the researcher uses self-experiments to find the procedural parameters (e.g., duration, time of day, intensity) that optimize the solution or maximize the effect. Only then would the researcher begin conventional experiments, using the optimized parameters.

다음 문장의 부분을 문맥에 맞게 어형 변환하시오.

"The researcher uses self-experiments to find parameters that __________(optimization) the solution." (영어로)

det.korean: optimization → optimize: 관계대명사 that 뒤에 동사가 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ optimize(최적화하다, 동사): optimization(명사)의 동사형
det.tip: optimize(최적화하다, 동사) → optimization(최적화, 명사)

questions.passage: When self-experimentation and conventional experiments are both possible, the difference between them often resembles the difference between learning and showing: Self-experiments are better for discovery but worse for convincing others that the solution is helpful or the answer is correct. Of course, most scientists want to do both—discover something and convince others of their discovery. Thus, psychologists should consider doing both self-experiments and conventional ones. The best use of resources may often be self-experiments followed by conventional ones. The researcher begins with self-experiments that, if all goes well, find large effects and/or generate and eliminate many hypotheses. This __________ and theory-building phase lasts until a convenient solution or large effect is found. Then the researcher uses self-experiments to find the procedural parameters (e.g., duration, time of day, intensity) that optimize the solution or maximize the effect. Only then would the researcher begin conventional experiments, using the optimized parameters.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 자원의 최선 활용은 자기실험 후 통상적 실험(self-experiments followed by conventional ones)이다.
